question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dissolve
solution:
The correct answer is: **Appear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"dissolve"** means to become incorporated into a liquid so as to form a solution, or to disappear. (घुलना / समाप्त हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The sugar will dissolve in the tea.
 
 
 
• **"Appear" **means to come into sight or become visible, the opposite of disappearing or dissolving. (प्रकट होना)
 
 
• **Example: **As the fog lifted, the mountain range appeared in the distance.
